### isothermalEvaporation2d

A flat interface evaporates due to a lower pressure assigned to the boundary.
This example is run in lattice units, but can be easily changed to physical units by prescribing the values of the parameters in physical units.
This example can be used to compare the LBM solution for simple evaporation with the analytical solution proposed in [@czelusniak2025analytical].
